mechanics.timing: An Infection deck card. The city name is the only printed text.
rules: LAGOS is printed vertically in the right-hand banner, reading top to bottom.
The card face is yellow, with a green crosshair and a faint biohazard mark.
No coordinates, population, or rules text are printed.
Epidemic step 2 draws the bottom Infection card, removes all Supply cubes from that city, and discards the card.
